checklist.why: "The one container surface" - no use-X-instead (TaskGroup card, Row group, Facts).
Only "do not nest"; no when-not naming an alternative.
Border, radius, padding and context background named.
The real variants (padded content, row list with 0 padding, facts dl, log) are not listed; they live in other cards.
The tag option allows section/dl; no role needed.
Uses a parallel --st-* namespace with raw hex roots (--st-line:#dfe4d8, --st-inset:#f6f8f1) and raw 16/12px padding instead of the tokens.css names.
Does not link Facts, Row group, Log, TaskTotals or TaskProgress, which are all built on it.
The 375 preview renders both contexts without overflow (cramped at about 187px each).

findings.text: Its job is unclear: screens almost never call panel() directly - it is the surface under Facts, Row group, Log, TaskTotals, TaskProgress and TaskSection. The card reads like a component you pick, so the owner cannot tell what it is for.
findings.fix: Rewrite the purpose: "The surface every grouped block sits on; you rarely call it - use Facts, Row group or Log", and list those as its variants.

findings.text: Three look-alikes skip it: the TaskGroup card (paper, line, radius-panel plus a 0 2px 8px shadow, against "panels are not shadowed"), ChoiceList .st-choice-panel, and the chooser .catalog-* lists.
findings.fix: Build TaskGroup and .st-choice-panel on .st-panel; drop the TaskGroup shadow or name it the one sanctioned exception.

findings.text: A parallel token namespace (--st-line, --st-inset, --st-radius) with raw hex roots duplicates tokens.css.
findings.fix: Point --st-* at tokens (--st-line: var(--line), and so on) or use the tokens directly.

findings.text: The preview shows a paragraph in a panel - a use no screen has.
findings.fix: Preview the real variants: a Facts block and a Row group, page vs drawer.

resolution.note: Findings addressed in the component pass; original judge scores preserved.
changes: Purpose and consumer ownership documented; page/drawer specimens render Facts and Row group.
TaskGroup, ChoiceList, Farrowing pen cards and catalogue lists use st-panel; shadows and nested chooser surfaces retired.
Existing token aliases verified; default surface works without an explicit context.
